positions.name: SlugGenerationWithoutId
positions.frame: What must the pipeline do when a memory is submitted without an explicit id?
positions.why: src-1 reports the triggering condition as settled fact — the submission carried no explicit id field — while src-2 directs the required outcome from that condition: a slug produced from the memory content, whether through the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, and the file committed successfully. Read together, the two expressions form one requirement context: the condition and the obligation it imposes. The deontic 'must' in src-2 sits against the plain past report in src-1 without tension — the report supplies what the directive answers.
